name: Electronic Measurements
description: Measurement principles of oscilloscope, impedance analyzer, spectrum analyzer. Other lab equipment: signal generator, voltage source. Controlling equipment through programming. Sources of error. Noise in measurement and ground loops. Sensitive measurements: impedance measurement including open-short calibrations; mutual inductance measurement, current measurement, noise measurement. RF measurement; network analyzers; SOLT calibration in brief. Noise figure measurement.
